description: The plot illustrates the performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on Llama2. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a logarithmic scale, and ranges from 3 to 1000 with tick labels at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)", has a linear scale, and ranges from 55 to 80 with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. There are six lines in the plot, each representing a different editing method: Base (black, circle marker, solid line), FT (blue, square marker, dashed line), IKE (red, triangle marker, dash-dot line), MEND (purple, diamond marker, solid line), MEMIT (pink, star marker, dashed line), and ROME (green, cross marker, solid line). The Base line starts at around 63% and ends at around 68%, increasing steadily across the x-axis. The FT line starts at around 67% and ends at around 72%, also increasing steadily. The IKE line starts at around 69% and ends at around 74%, showing a similar trend. The MEND line starts at around 72% and ends at around 77%, increasing steadily. The MEMIT line starts at around 74% and ends at around 79%, also increasing steadily. The ROME line starts at around 76% and ends at around 80%, showing a steady increase across the x-axis.
